consequence.statement: The `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag still works in Cilium 1.16 but is scheduled for removal in Cilium 1.17. Operators should migrate to the `clustermesh-sync-timeout` flag before upgrading to 1.17.

original.statement: The `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` CLI flag has been deprecated in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout` and will be removed in Cilium 1.17.

decision.reason: [ev-07d6be356398] lists the flag under "Deprecated Options". It says the flag is deprecated in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout` and will be removed in Cilium 1.17. The evidence says removal comes in a later release and says nothing about the flag failing or being ignored in 1.16, so deprecation (a review item) is the right kind. The statement's advice to move to `clustermesh-sync-timeout` before 1.17 matches the named replacement.
